description: Restructure the Student Dashboard, Super Admin Dashboard, and Partner Portal sidebars to use collapsible navigation groups. Adds 'Learning Resources' nav item to all three dashboards. Updates roleConfig.js to support a menuGroups[] structure alongside the flat menuItems[]. Updates Sidebar.jsx to render grouped sections with collapse/expand. Does NOT remove any existing pages or routes — only reorganises navigation. Independent of FEAT-001. Depends on FEAT-002 only for the Learning Resources nav item path which must already be routed.
steps: 2. EDIT frontend/src/components/dashboard/common/Sidebar.jsx — add grouped rendering support while keeping backward compatibility with the existing flat menuItems path. Changes: a) Import ChevronDown, ChevronRight from 'lucide-react' (add to existing imports). b) Add local state: `const [openGroups, setOpenGroups] = useState({})`. c) Add helper `toggleGroup(label)` that flips openGroups[label]. d) Read from config: `const menuGroups = config.menuGroups`. e) Add a new render function `renderGroupedNav()` that: iterates over menuGroups; for each group with label===null renders items directly as flat NavLinks (same markup as existing); for each group with a label renders a section header button (collapsible if group.collapsible===true) that shows the label + ChevronDown/ChevronRight icon, and below it renders the NavLinks (collapsed/expanded based on openGroups[group.label], default open = true so existing users see everything on first load); groups default to open by storing `openGroups` as `{}` and treating absence as open. f) In the main render: if `menuGroups` exists, use `renderGroupedNav()` in place of the existing `{menuItems.map(...)}` block; otherwise fall back to existing flat rendering. g) Keep all existing NavLink styling (neo-dash-nav-link, neo-dash-nav-link--active), badge rendering for supportMenu items, and the Sign Out button unchanged. h) Group section headers use class `neo-sidebar-group-header` (plain div/button, px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#4B5563] flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-black/5 rounded-lg transition-colors).

3. Verify no existing pages are removed: search frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx for all previously existing route paths — none should be deleted. The new learning-resources routes added in FEAT-002 must be present.

4. FINAL CHECK: ensure all icons used in menuGroups are imported in roleConfig.js. BookOpen is already imported. All other icons (LayoutDashboard, User, FileText, Briefcase, ThumbsUp, BarChart2, Settings, Users, PlusCircle, Star, Globe2, Brain, Headphones, LifeBuoy, CreditCard, ShieldCheck, Target, ListChecks, Gauge, CheckCircle2, Award, TrendingUp, GitBranch, Map, MessageSquare) were already present in the original file — confirm they remain in the import block.
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend && npm run build completes with 0 errors
Student Dashboard sidebar shows collapsible groups: Career Development group collapses/expands on click
Admin Dashboard sidebar shows Learning Resources item under Content & Learning group
Partner Dashboard sidebar shows Learning Resources item under Learning group
All previously existing nav items are still present in their respective dashboards (none removed)
Sidebar still falls back to flat menuItems rendering if menuGroups is not defined on a role
No console errors on sidebar render for any role
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — must complete with 0 errors
cd frontend && npm run test — all existing Vitest tests must still pass
Manual: open Student Dashboard, click Career Development group header — items should collapse and expand. Click Learning Resources — should navigate to /dashboard/learning-resources
